headline: 8 core protocol addresses and governance/treasury wallets discovered across Solana; Eclipse deployment confirmed but Eclipse-specific addresses not yet retrieved.
short_headline: 8 Solana addresses catalogued; Eclipse deployment pending

findings.text: Solana mainnet: Whirlpools program whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc (official deployment) and ORCA token orcaEKTdK7LKz57vaAYr9QeNsVEPfiu6QeMU1kektZE identified from multiple authoritative sources.

Token Treasury documentation page (docs.orca.so) lists deployed contracts and wallet addresses including Fee Treasury (DWo8SNtdBDuebAEeVDf7cWBQ6DUvoDbS7K4QTrQvYS1S), Climate Fund (DrhE25wu3PRGtBCtzsry6ToiGjhwBzCnYGpvv53qxh9X), and Community ORCA Treasury (GwH3Hiv5mACLX3ufTw1pFsrhSPon5tdw252DBs4Rx4PV).

GitHub repository (orca-so/whirlpools) contains audit PDFs for Kudelski Security (2022-01-28), Neodyme (2022-05-05), OtterSec (2024-08-21), and Sec3 (2025-02-28, 2025-06-23, 2025-08-22). Specific contract addresses in-scope not yet extracted from PDFs.

Eclipse deployment confirmed live as secondary chain. Medium post (2024-10-29) states Orca is live on Eclipse mainnet with deep liquidity pools, but no Eclipse-specific contract addresses discovered yet.
All Solana addresses extracted from fetched docs and search results; Eclipse-specific addresses (D5) require direct fetch of Eclipse block explorer or Orca's Eclipse deployment documentation.

rationale.verdict: Discovery phase enumeration: 8 addresses identified and cited on Solana (1 program, 1 governance token, 4 treasury/governance wallets, 1 source wallet, 1 account holding undistributed fees). Eclipse is confirmed as a second deployment chain but no Eclipse-specific contract addresses catalogued; next assessments should fetch Eclipse explorer or Eclipse-specific docs. GitHub audit directory confirmed; PDF extraction needed for full in-scope contract lists.

evidence.shows: Official Orca Whirlpools repository; README confirms official deployment address whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc on Solana mainnet and devnet; audits directory contains PDFs from Kudelski Security, Neodyme, OtterSec, and Sec3.

ORCA token SPL address orcaEKTdK7LKz57vaAYr9QeNsVEPfiu6QeMU1kektZE with issuance date Aug 9, 2021. Lists Fee Treasury (DWo8SNtdBDuebAEeVDf7cWBQ6DUvoDbS7K4QTrQvYS1S), Climate Fund (DrhE25wu3PRGtBCtzsry6ToiGjhwBzCnYGpvv53qxh9X), Community ORCA Treasury (GwH3Hiv5mACLX3ufTw1pFsrhSPon5tdw252DBs4Rx4PV), and token initial source wallet (GjKxauMroc9MT27xXYyjLYNfy9nSS5EuHTmzhdkjCAR1).

Orca is live on Eclipse mainnet as Eclipse's primary DEX; deep liquidity pools and permissionless pool creation confirmed. Published 2024-10-29. Mentions documentation available at Orca docs but specific Eclipse contract addresses not provided in this article.

Confirms official Orca Whirlpool Program ID on Solana mainnet is whirLbMiicVdio4qvUfM5KAg6Ct8VwpYzGff3uctyCc, deployed as open-source contract audited by Kudelski Security and Neodyme. ORCA token serves as governance token with hard-capped 100M supply.

ORCA is governance token for Orca protocol launched in September 2021 with fixed 100M max supply. Protocol employs ORCA token for governance allowing token holders to participate in decision-making. Audited by Kudelski Security and Neodyme; all funds secured by multi-sig wallets.

unknowns: D2-offchain: Orca deployed_contracts_doc page not yet fetched; TOKEN_TREASURY at docs.orca.so provides some addresses but comprehensive deployment list may exist elsewhere in docs hierarchy.
D3-offchain: Audit PDF files referenced in GitHub (.audits/) not yet fetched; specific in-scope contract names and addresses in audit reports unknown.

D5: Eclipse-specific Whirlpools program address and contract deployments not discovered; requires fetch of Eclipse block explorer (explorer.eclipse.builders or equivalent) or Orca's Eclipse-specific deployment documentation.

D6: No factory enumeration attempted; Whirlpools is not a factory pattern (pools are created but not via a child-enumeration view). All user-created pools are dynamically generated; capping strategy not applicable.
D7: All discovered addresses lack actor_class classification (EOA vs multisig status); on-chain bytecode inspection or Safe registry check needed for D2-era treasury/governance wallets.

protocol_metadata.about: <cite index="8-23,8-24">Orca is a decentralized exchange (DEX) and automated market maker (AMM) built on the Solana blockchain, launched in February 2021</cite>, with <cite index="8-17">co-founders Grace Kwan and Yutaro Mori</cite>. <cite index="7-6">It utilizes a concentrated liquidity model for improved capital efficiency and offers features like Whirlpools for customizable liquidity positions</cite>. <cite index="9-1">Orca is now live on Eclipse mainnet as Eclipse's primary DEX</cite>, and the protocol is <cite index="25-8">governed via the ORCA token for governance, allowing token holders to participate in decision-making processes</cite>.
